abilities.name: Crown of Thorns
abilities.description:
Damaging Enemy Heroes applies Thorns to the target for 4s. Additional applications refresh the duration. Cannot be applied to Epic Monsters.

Allies deal 6% of their damage as bonus true damage to Enemies afflicted by Thorns.

abilities.name: Royal Flourish
abilities.description:
Adele swings her sword, gaining 40% Movement Speed for the duration. She deals 5.0/15.0/25.0/35.0/45.0 (+50.0/60.0/70.0/80.0/90.0% physical power) physical damage twice to nearby Enemies and Mesmerizes them for 1s. Mesmerized Enemies are immune to Slows. 

Adele then slams her sword down in an area to deal 70.0/90.0/110.0/130.0/150.0 (+7% max health) true damage to all Enemies hit.

abilities.name: Iron Rose
